bull_case_summary: IOI Properties has CFO rising to RM2.391bn and RM1.780bn after specified ordinary asset outlays before acquisitions and interest. Round two uses this real operating contribution to preserve a speculative asset-conversion scenario independent of noncash gains.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts operating cash but notes RM3.258bn net borrowing drawdowns and RM21.818bn net debt before leases. Noncash gains comprise 51.31% of PBT, so the 8.54x headline multiple overstates recurring cheapness versus 17.71x forecasts.
key_points_of_agreement: Noncash gains make headline reported valuation misleading.
The ordinary investment surplus excludes acquisitions and interest.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether future asset conversion can compensate already-observed financing dependence and less-forgiving recurring valuation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Delivered recurring returns from acquisitions and property operations.
Funding discipline and sustained cash after all expansion and interest demands.
